text:
Ava: Heads up — marketing needs the final changelog snippet + docs URLs for the announcement going out tomorrow 16:00 PT. Who can confirm the final changelog lines?

Ravi: I can take changelog freeze in 30m. Is the headline 'Adaptive Autoscale for Redwood Dedicated'?

Lena: Docs staging link: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/autoscale-preview. Need final signoff for the quickstart + code samples.

Omar: Suggest headline tweak: 'Autoscale Preview — predictable throughput for variable workloads' — better for the benchmark narrative and webinar framing.

Ava: Good. Bench narrative will emphasize ~2.5x throughput at P95 with cost savings. Sofia, are we locking the webinar date?

Sofia: Yes — webinar Wed Oct 23 11:00am PT. Landing page draft is up. Need final speaker blurbs and the live demo checklist from Eng.

Ravi: Demo plan (high level): scale from 1 -> 50 rps, show KV cache warmup, and fallback to a smaller model variant during burst. Changelog snippet to propose now:

```
- Feature: Adaptive Autoscale (preview) — automatic reserved GPU scaling for variable workload patterns.
- Improvement: KV prefix cache persistence to reduce cold-start token cost by up to 40%.
- Fix: routing fallback on multi-tenant pools to avoid 503 spikes.
```

Lena: I'll patch the quickstart and include the CLI flags once we lock the exact API surface.

Omar: Important: public docs URL must be canonical in the release note. Do not link staging. @Lena can you confirm the public route?

Ava: Also — any post-deploy migrations or schema changes that could affect the deploy window? Need confirmation for the 16:00 PT publish.

Ravi: No migrations. Canary at 10% for 2 hours, automated rollback on error. release-bot is scheduled for the canary deploy at 2024-10-18T23:00:00Z.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled by Ravi into canary. Promotion to prod will occur after 2h if health checks pass.

Sofia: For inbound leads, marketing wants a direct 'Schedule a demo' CTA on the announcement and webinar page. Please route to SDR queue `autoscale-2024`. Need product tagging so leads are labelled.

Omar: I'll add the GA and product tags on the release route. @Lena can you confirm the webhook for the lead form?

Lena: Confirmed — webhook: https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead/autoscale-2024. I'll add it to the landing page and the announcement CTA.

Ava: Final checklist: Eng — freeze changelog (Ravi), provide public docs URL (Lena), confirm demo runbook (Ravi), confirm deploy window (Ravi). Marketing — finalize copy, CTA, and webinar invite (Sofia).

Ava: We'll do a 15-min pre-deploy sync 30m before the canary. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Sofia: Added to calendar: Pre-deploy 2024-10-18T22:30:00Z.

Ravi: I'll post the final changelog in this thread after the freeze.
